# Pathao Synthetic Ride-Sharing Dataset — Data Dictionary

**Scope:** 14 JSONL event/master-data files generated by `generate.py`
**Time range:** 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31, Asia/Dhaka (+06:00, fixed offset, no DST)
**Format:** newline-delimited JSON (one object per line)
**Types below use SQL/warehouse-style typing** (VARCHAR, DECIMAL, TIMESTAMP, DATE, INTEGER, BOOLEAN, JSON) for direct use in PostgreSQL DDL.

---

## 1. customers.json — Customer Master

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| customer_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Primary key | `CUST0000001` | Unique, format `CUST` + 7-digit zero-padded number |
| full_name | VARCHAR(100) | No | Customer's full name | `Sajib Khan` | Bangladeshi first + last name |
| gender | VARCHAR(10) | No | Gender | `Male` | Enum: `Male`, `Female` |
| age | INTEGER | No | Age in years | `44` | Range: 18–60 |
| signup_date | DATE | No | Date of account signup | `2024-04-07` | ~80% before dataset window, ~20% during it |
| home_zone | VARCHAR(30) | No | Customer's home Dhaka zone | `Kuril` | One of 20 defined Dhaka zones |
| preferred_payment_method | VARCHAR(20) | No | Default payment method | `Cash` | Enum: `Cash` (50%), `Card` (25%), `Pathao Wallet` (25%) |
| customer_segment | VARCHAR(20) | No | Behavioral/value segment | `Frequent` | Enum: `New` (30%), `Regular` (40%), `Frequent` (20%), `Premium` (10%) |
| device_type | VARCHAR(10) | No | Mobile OS | `Android` | Enum: `Android` (75%), `iOS` (25%) |
| app_version | VARCHAR(10) | No | App version at last known use | `8.3.0` | One of 7 recent version strings |

---

## 2. drivers.json — Driver Master

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| driver_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Primary key | `DRV0000001` | Unique, format `DRV` + 7-digit number |
| full_name | VARCHAR(100) | No | Driver's full name | `Jannat Ahmed` | Bangladeshi first + last name |
| gender | VARCHAR(10) | No | Gender | `Female` | Enum: `Male`, `Female` |
| rating | DECIMAL(3,2) | No | Overall driver rating | `4.33` | Range: 3.8–5.0 |
| experience_years | DECIMAL(4,1) | No | Years of driving experience | `2.3` | Derived from join_date, capped at 15.0 |
| join_date | DATE | No | Date driver joined platform | `2023-09-25` | 30–1500 days before dataset start |
| online_status | BOOLEAN | No | Currently online flag | `false` | ~55% online at generation time |
| online_since | TIMESTAMP | **Yes** | Timestamp driver went online | `null` | Null when `online_status` is `false` |
| vehicle_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → vehicles.json | `VEH0000001` | Each active driver maps 1:1 to a vehicle |

---

## 3. vehicles.json — Vehicle Master

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| vehicle_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Primary key | `VEH0000001` | Unique, format `VEH` + 7-digit number |
| vehicle_type | VARCHAR(10) | No | Vehicle category | `Car` | Enum: `Bike` (55%), `Car` (35%), `CNG` (10%) |
| brand | VARCHAR(30) | No | Manufacturer | `Toyota` | Depends on vehicle_type |
| model | VARCHAR(30) | No | Model name | `Corolla` | Depends on brand |
| registration_number | VARCHAR(30) | No | License plate | `DHAKA METRO-JA-14-4657` | Format: `DHAKA METRO-<series>-<zone>-<number>` |
| manufacturing_year | INTEGER | No | Year manufactured | `2017` | Range: 2015–2025 |

*Note: not every vehicle is assigned to a driver — the pool includes spare/unassigned vehicles.*

## 4. promotion.json — Promotion Campaigns

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| promotion_id | VARCHAR(10) | No | Primary key | `PROMO0001` | Unique, format `PROMO` + 4-digit number |
| coupon_code | VARCHAR(20) | No | Redeemable coupon code | `NEWUSER100` | 6 fixed campaign codes |
| campaign_name | VARCHAR(100) | No | Human-readable campaign name | `New User Welcome Offer` | — |
| discount_type | VARCHAR(15) | No | How the discount is calculated | `Flat` | Enum: `Flat`, `Percentage` |
| discount_value | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Discount amount or percent | `100` | BDT if Flat, % if Percentage |
| minimum_fare | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Minimum fare to qualify | `50` | One of 50/80/100/120 |
| maximum_discount | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Cap on total discount | `200` | One of 50/100/150/200 |
| campaign_start | DATE | No | Campaign start date | `2026-02-20` | Within dataset window |
| campaign_end | DATE | No | Campaign end date | `2026-03-09` | 7–30 days after start |
| funded_by | VARCHAR(30) | No | Funding source | `Merchant Partner` | Enum: `Pathao`, `Merchant Partner`, `Marketing Budget` |
| eligible_payment_methods | JSON | No | Payment methods coupon applies to | `["Card","Pathao Wallet","Cash"]` | Array of 1–3 of `Cash`/`Card`/`Pathao Wallet` |
| maximum_usage | INTEGER | No | Max redemptions allowed | `5000` | One of 1000/5000/10000/20000 |

## 5. ride_requested.json — Ride Request Events

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| event_id | VARCHAR(15) | No | Primary key | `EVT-RQ0000001` | Unique per request event |
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Ride identifier (shared across all lifecycle events) | `RIDE0000001` | Foreign key referenced by every downstream file |
| customer_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Requesting customer | `CUST0002140` | Foreign key → customers.json |
| pickup | JSON | No | Pickup location | `{"zone":"Uttara","latitude":23.872486,"longitude":90.381962}` | Nested: `zone` VARCHAR, `latitude`/`longitude` DECIMAL |
| destination | JSON | No | Destination location | `{"zone":"Dhanmondi","latitude":23.743869,"longitude":90.376378}` | Same shape as `pickup` |
| requested_timestamp | TIMESTAMP | No | When the ride was requested | `2026-03-11T10:33:59.833+06:00` | ISO-8601, Asia/Dhaka offset |
| estimated_distance_km | DECIMAL(8,2) | No | Estimated distance | `20.37` | Straight-line × road factor (1.25–1.6) |
| estimated_duration_min | DECIMAL(8,1) | No | Estimated duration | `48.2` | Based on distance and time-of-day speed |
| estimated_fare | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Estimated fare (pre-discount) | `303.0` | Includes surge multiplier |
| ride_type | VARCHAR(10) | No | Vehicle category for the ride | `Bike` | Enum: `Bike`, `Car`, `CNG` |
| service_type | VARCHAR(15) | No | Service tier | `Standard` | Enum: `Standard` (65%), `Premium` (15%), `Pool` (20%) |
| metadata.app_version | VARCHAR(10) | No | App version used to request | `8.6.0` | — |
| metadata.device_type | VARCHAR(10) | No | Device OS | `Android` | — |
| metadata.platform | VARCHAR(20) | No | Request platform | `mobile_app` | Constant in this dataset |
| metadata.city | VARCHAR(20) | No | City | `Dhaka` | Constant |
| metadata.coupon_applied | BOOLEAN | No | Whether a coupon was successfully applied | `true` | — |
| metadata.coupon_code | VARCHAR(20) | **Yes** | Coupon code attempted | `FLASH30` | Null if no coupon attempted |
| metadata.promotion_id | VARCHAR(10) | **Yes** | Foreign key → promotion.json | `PROMO0004` | Null if no coupon attempted |
| metadata.discount_amount | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Discount amount (0 if not applied) | `90.9` | — |
| metadata.promotion_success | BOOLEAN | **Yes** | Whether the coupon attempt succeeded | `true` | Null if no coupon attempted |
| metadata.coupon_redemption_status | VARCHAR(25) | No | Outcome detail | `redeemed` | Enum: `not_attempted`, `redeemed`, `not_applied_forgot`, `misunderstood_terms`, `below_minimum_fare` |
| metadata.surge_reasons | JSON | No | Active surge conditions | `[]` | Array subset of `Peak Hours`, `Rain`, `Special Event` |

## 6. driver_assigned.json — Driver Assignment Events

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| event_id | VARCHAR(15) | No | Primary key | `EVT-DA0000001` | — |
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → ride_requested.json | `RIDE0000001` | — |
| driver_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → drivers.json | `DRV0000835` | — |
| assignment_algorithm | VARCHAR(30) | No | Matching algorithm used | `nearest_driver_v3` | Enum: `nearest_driver_v3`, `highest_rated_match`, `least_busy_pool`, `hybrid_ml_v2` |
| assigned_timestamp | TIMESTAMP | No | When driver was assigned | `2026-03-11T10:34:25.833+06:00` | 5–45 seconds after request |
| estimated_arrival_min | DECIMAL(6,1) | No | ETA to pickup | `6.2` | Derived from distance_to_pickup_km |
| distance_to_pickup_km | DECIMAL(6,2) | No | Driver's distance from pickup | `2.15` | Range: 0.3–4.5 km |

*Emitted for every ride except the `No Driver Found` outcome.*

---

## 7. driver_accepted.json — Driver Acceptance Events

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| event_id | VARCHAR(15) | No | Primary key | `EVT-DC0000001` | — |
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → ride_requested.json | `RIDE0000001` | — |
| driver_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → drivers.json | `DRV0000835` | — |
| accepted_timestamp | TIMESTAMP | No | When driver accepted | `2026-03-11T10:35:00.833+06:00` | — |
| driver_rating | DECIMAL(3,2) | No | Driver's rating at acceptance time | `4.58` | Snapshot from drivers.json |
| acceptance_delay_seconds | INTEGER | No | Delay between assignment and acceptance | `35` | Range: 3–40 seconds |

*Not emitted for `No Driver Found` or `Driver Timeout` outcomes.*

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| event_id | VARCHAR(15) | No | Primary key | `EVT-DR0000001` | — |
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → ride_requested.json | `RIDE0000001` | — |
| arrival_timestamp | TIMESTAMP | No | When driver arrived at pickup | `2026-03-11T10:38:14.833+06:00` | — |

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |

| event_id | VARCHAR(15) | No | Primary key | `EVT-RS0000001` | — |

## 10. ride_completed.json — Ride Completion Events

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| event_id | VARCHAR(15) | No | Primary key | `EVT-RC0000001` | — |
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → ride_requested.json | `RIDE0000001` | — |
| driver_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → drivers.json | `DRV0000835` | — |
| customer_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → customers.json | `CUST0002140` | — |
| distance_km | DECIMAL(8,2) | No | Actual distance traveled | `19.96` | 92–115% of estimated distance |
| duration_min | DECIMAL(8,1) | No | Actual trip duration | `55.4` | 85–135% of estimated duration |
| average_speed_kmh | DECIMAL(6,1) | No | Average speed | `21.6` | Derived from distance/duration |
| fare | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Final fare charged (post-discount) | `212.94` | Minimum 10 BDT |
| waiting_charge | DECIMAL(8,2) | No | Extra charge for wait time beyond 3 free minutes | `0.0` | BDT 2/min after free allowance |
| surge_multiplier | DECIMAL(3,2) | No | Surge multiplier applied | `1.0` | One of 1.0, 1.2, 1.5, 2.0 |
| discount | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Discount amount applied | `90.9` | 0 if no coupon redeemed |
| driver_payout | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Amount paid to driver | `170.35` | 80% of fare |
| platform_commission | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Platform's commission | `42.59` | 20% of fare |
| ride_rating_customer | DECIMAL(2,1) | **Yes** | Rating given by customer | `4.0` | Range 3.5–5.0; ~8% null (not rated) |
| ride_rating_driver | DECIMAL(2,1) | **Yes** | Rating given by driver | `4.4` | Range 3.5–5.0; ~8% null (not rated) |
| completed_timestamp | TIMESTAMP | No | When the ride completed | `2026-03-11T11:36:36.833+06:00` | — |

---

## 11. ride_cancelled.json — Cancellation Events

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Primary key — foreign key → ride_requested.json | `RIDE0000009` | One cancellation record per cancelled ride |
| cancelled_by | VARCHAR(10) | No | Who initiated the cancellation | `System` | Enum: `Customer`, `Driver`, `System` |
| reason | VARCHAR(40) | No | Cancellation reason | `No Driver Found` | One of 8 defined reasons (see below) |
| timestamp | TIMESTAMP | No | When the cancellation occurred | `2026-03-06T19:13:21.905+06:00` | — |
| stage_reached | VARCHAR(20) | No | Last lifecycle stage reached before cancellation | `ride_requested` | Enum: `ride_requested`, `driver_assigned`, `driver_accepted` |

**Reason values:** `Driver Taking Too Long`, `Customer Changed Mind`, `Wrong Pickup`, `Traffic`, `Coupon Payment Confusion`, `No Driver Found`, `Payment Issue`, `Emergency`

---

## 12. payment.json — Payment Transactions

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| payment_id | VARCHAR(14) | No | Primary key | `PAY00000001` | Unique, format `PAY` + 8-digit number |
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → ride_requested.json | `RIDE0000001` | Only exists for rides that reached `ride_completed` |
| payment_method | VARCHAR(20) | No | Method used | `Card` | Enum: `Cash` (50%), `Card` (25%), `Pathao Wallet` (25%) |
| payment_status | VARCHAR(15) | No | Transaction outcome | `Pending` | Enum: `Completed` (90%), `Pending` (4%), `Failed` (6%) |
| transaction_time | TIMESTAMP | No | When the transaction was processed | `2026-03-11T11:37:05.833+06:00` | 2–60 seconds after ride completion |
| amount | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Amount charged | `212.94` | Matches `ride_completed.fare` |
| discount | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Discount applied | `90.9` | Matches `ride_completed.discount` |
| commission | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Platform commission | `42.59` | Matches `ride_completed.platform_commission` |
| driver_payout | DECIMAL(10,2) | No | Amount paid to driver | `0` | 0 if payment_status is not `Completed` |

---

## 13. gps_logs.json — GPS Location Events

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → ride_requested.json | `RIDE0000001` | Composite key with driver_id + timestamp (no standalone gps_id) |
| driver_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → drivers.json | `DRV0000835` | — |
| timestamp | TIMESTAMP | No | GPS ping timestamp | `2026-03-11T10:41:12.833+06:00` | Emitted every 10–20 seconds during the trip |
| latitude | DECIMAL(9,6) | No | Latitude at ping time | `23.871253` | 6 decimal places |
| longitude | DECIMAL(9,6) | No | Longitude at ping time | `90.381062` | 6 decimal places |
| speed_kmh | DECIMAL(5,1) | No | Instantaneous speed | `4.3` | Gaussian noise around segment average |
| heading | INTEGER | No | Direction of travel | `328` | Range: 0–359 degrees |
| accuracy_m | DECIMAL(5,1) | No | GPS accuracy | `24.5` | Range: 3–25 meters |

*Data quality: ~5% of expected pings are dropped (missing), ~2% arrive out of chronological order — both intentional to mimic real mobile GPS behavior.*

---

## 14. customer_support.json — Support Tickets

| Field | Type | Nullable | Description | Example | Constraints / Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ticket_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Primary key | `TICKET000001` | Unique, format `TICKET` + 6-digit number |
| ride_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → ride_requested.json | `RIDE0000028` | — |
| customer_id | VARCHAR(12) | No | Foreign key → customers.json | `CUST0000404` | — |
| issue_category | VARCHAR(40) | No | Nature of the complaint | `Wrong fare` | One of 7 defined categories (see below) |
| priority | VARCHAR(10) | No | Ticket priority | `High` | Enum: `Low` (40%), `Medium` (40%), `High` (15%), `Critical` (5%) |
| resolution_status | VARCHAR(15) | No | Current ticket status | `Pending` | Enum: `Resolved` (60%), `Pending` (25%), `Escalated` (15%) |
| created_at | TIMESTAMP | No | When the ticket was opened | `2026-02-27T11:30:21.057+06:00` | 1–240 minutes after the triggering event |
| resolved_at | TIMESTAMP | **Yes** | When the ticket was resolved | `null` | Null unless `resolution_status` is `Resolved` |

**Issue category values:** `Coupon not applied`, `Driver behavior`, `Wrong fare`, `Late driver`, `Payment deducted twice`, `Wallet issue`, `Ride cancelled automatically`

---

## Cross-File Relationships (Foreign Keys)

```
customers.json (customer_id) ──┬─< ride_requested.json (customer_id)
                                ├─< ride_completed.json (customer_id)
                                └─< customer_support.json (customer_id)

drivers.json (driver_id) ───────┬─< driver_assigned.json (driver_id)
                                 ├─< driver_accepted.json (driver_id)
                                 ├─< ride_completed.json (driver_id)
                                 └─< gps_logs.json (driver_id)

drivers.json (vehicle_id) ──────> vehicles.json (vehicle_id)

ride_requested.json (ride_id) ──┬─< driver_assigned.json (ride_id)
                                 ├─< driver_accepted.json (ride_id)
                                 ├─< driver_arrived.json (ride_id)
                                 ├─< ride_started.json (ride_id)
                                 ├─< ride_completed.json (ride_id)
                                 ├─< ride_cancelled.json (ride_id)
                                 ├─< payment.json (ride_id)
                                 ├─< gps_logs.json (ride_id)
                                 └─< customer_support.json (ride_id)

promotion.json (promotion_id) ──> ride_requested.json (metadata.promotion_id)
```
